posts.title: Choosing your keyholders
posts.description: Threshold cryptography is a math problem until the moment of recovery, when it becomes a social one. A short field guide to picking, briefing, and rotating the people who hold your shares.

posts.title: Choosing your m-of-n threshold
posts.description: Threshold cryptography gives you two dials, and choosing them well is most of the work. A short tour of the failure modes, the standard configurations, and the heuristics that keep them working.

posts.title: Cyclic Dependencies in Personal Security
posts.description: Almost everyone's recovery plan contains a hidden loop. The cycles stay invisible in normal use, and become unrecoverable the moment something breaks.
